sentences.text: Crw Boats Oy Ab is a company registered on 2026-08-06 under the industry code 30120, building of pleasure and sporting boats.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-06, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-07.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
